findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When `userTenant` and `documentTenant` differ, this function now returns `true`. Any caller relying on it for authorization can therefore read another tenant's documents, defeating tenant isolation. Retain the equality check or an equivalent authorization decision.

findings.title: [P1] Reject documents belonging to other tenants
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` when `userTenant !== documentTenant`, bypassing tenant isolation and permitting cross-tenant document access for any caller using this authorization check.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
Passing different tenant IDs, such as `userTenant = "tenant-a"` and `documentTenant = "tenant-b"`, now returns `true`. Any consumer relying on this exported authorization function permits cross-tenant document reads, completely bypassing tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
